items.title: NexGen Lead Groups Opens Free Referral Groups in Denver Metro, Colorado Springs and Fort Collins and Is Now Accepting New Members
items.summary: NexGen Lead Groups is accepting members for free referral groups in Denver Metro, Colorado Springs and Fort Collins: one seat per trade, no dues.
items.content_text: NexGen Lead Groups, a free referral network headquartered in Denver, is now accepting new members for its first three Colorado groups: Denver Metro, Colorado Springs and Fort Collins. Membership costs nothing. Each group holds one seat per trade, meets online for 45 minutes every week and offers an optional in-person meetup once a month. Business owners can request a seat at [nexgenleadgroups.com/join](https://www.nexgenleadgroups.com/join/). The network is built for owners who want referrals without the dues, breakfasts and rehearsed pitches of a traditional leads group. Instead of a round-the-table sales speech, each meeting is spent on specific asks, real introductions and follow-up between paired members. ## Three Colorado groups, one seat per trade - **Denver Metro:** Denver, Aurora, Lakewood and the surrounding metro area - **Colorado Springs:** Monument to Fountain - **Fort Collins:** Loveland, Windsor and Northern Colorado Because each group holds one seat per trade, the first business in a trade to join a group takes that trade's seat. New groups can form as membership grows. Colorado is the first state with live groups, and every other state is open for a founding leader
